essence: Read the signs around you: what people do tells you more than what they say.
modern_lens: Most of what happens at work arrives as small signals: a hurried reply, a change in tone, a team that goes quiet. Learn to read them early and test them against the facts before you act. Keep your own people's morale in view too, because a tired or unsure team cannot carry out a plan.

principles.name: Words Versus Actions
principles.gloss: Soft language backed by visible preparation signals a move forward. Talk of peace without binding terms often hides a delay.

principles.name: Read the Team's Mood
principles.gloss: Disorder, whispering and angry leaders reveal problems before anyone reports them. Investigate early, while it is still a conversation.

principles.name: Discipline After Trust
principles.gloss: Earn trust first, then enforce the rules the same way every time. Harsh discipline before trust gets you nothing.

principles.name: Watch Your Own Reserves
principles.gloss: Leaning on the spear and missing a clear opening are signs of exhaustion, in your team and in yourself.
